page.title: Your app's data.
page.intro: Everything your app saves, like messages, bookings and sign-ups. Open a table to see it, change it or download it.

panel.tableMissing: We couldn't find that table. It may have been removed.
panel.emptyTitle: Your app isn't saving anything yet.
panel.emptyBody: Add a feature like a contact form or bookings. When people use it, what they send shows up here.
panel.addFeatureHelp: Browse ready-made features, like a contact form or bookings. Each one sets up the tables it needs.
panel.openTableHelp: Open this table to see what’s saved in it. A table is like a spreadsheet: one row per record, such as each form someone sent.
panel.privacySubtitle: Find, download or erase what your app keeps about one person
panel.privacyHelp: Answer people who want a copy of what your app keeps about them, or want it deleted. You have 30 days to answer each request.
panel.advancedSubtitle: Where your data is stored, and making new tables
panel.advancedHelp: Technical setup: where your app’s data is kept, and making tables by hand. Most apps never need this.

table.rowsMatch: {count, plural, one {# row matches} other {# rows match}} “{search}”
table.addRowHelp: Type in a new record yourself. It’s saved to this table as soon as you add it.
table.downloadCsvHelp: Save this table as a file you can open in Excel or Google Sheets. It keeps your current search and sort, up to 50,000 rows.
table.searchHelp: Show only rows whose text contains these words (capital letters don’t matter). You can also type a row’s ID number.
table.deleteRows: Delete {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
table.deleteRowsHelp: Permanently deletes the rows you ticked. You’ll be asked to confirm first.
table.confirmText: Delete {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}? You can't undo this.
table.emptyBody: When people use your app, what they send shows up here.
table.emptyBodyEditable: When people use your app, what they send shows up here. You can also add rows yourself.
table.selectAll: Select all rows on this page
table.selectAllHelp: Tick every row on this page, for example to delete them together.
table.sortHelp: Sort the table by this column. Click again to flip the order.
table.selectRowHelp: Tick this row to delete it, along with any others you tick.
table.changeRowHelp: Open this row in a form to change several of its values at once. To change one value, just click it.
table.loadError: We couldn't load this table. Please try again.
table.actionError: That didn't work. Please try again.
table.cancelEditHelp: Stop changing this value without saving it. Pressing Esc does the same.
table.noColumns: This table has no columns you can fill in.

advanced.addSource: Add a place to store data
advanced.addSourceHelp: Connect somewhere new for your app to keep its data. Most apps never need this: adding a feature sets up storage for you.
advanced.internalHelp: Adds a separate storage area inside the studio’s own database. Postgres is the kind of database it is. Nothing else to set up.
advanced.internalBody: We create an isolated schema inside our Postgres. Zero config.
advanced.externalHelp: For developers: connect a Postgres database you already run elsewhere, using the connection address your database provider gives you.
advanced.externalBody: Bring your own database with a connection string.
advanced.sheetsHelp: Keep data in a Google spreadsheet. Connected with an API key, the sheet must be shared publicly, and your app can read it but not add to it.
advanced.sheetsBody: Use a spreadsheet as your database. Great for simple apps.
advanced.nameHelp: A name to help you recognise this data source in lists, like Main DB. Only you see it.
advanced.connectionHelp: The connection address from your database provider, starting with postgresql://. It contains the database password, so keep it private.
advanced.sheetIdHelp: The long code in the spreadsheet’s web address, between /d/ and /edit.
advanced.apiKeyPlaceholder: Google API key (for read-only public sheets)
advanced.apiKeyHelp: A key you create in your Google Cloud account. It only lets your app read spreadsheets that are shared publicly.
advanced.createHelp: Connects this data source. Your automation steps can then choose it.
advanced.sourcesHelp: Every place your app keeps data, with the tables in each. Automation steps choose from these.
advanced.newTableHelp: Make a new, empty table by hand (a table is like a spreadsheet), with the columns you choose.
advanced.tableNameHelp: The new table’s name. Use only letters, numbers and underscores, like blog_posts.
advanced.columnNameHelp: The name of this column, like title or price. Use only letters, numbers and underscores.
advanced.columnTypeHelp: What this column holds: text, int (whole number), float (number with decimals), bool (yes or no), timestamp (date and time) or json (structured data).
advanced.removeColumnHelp: Removes this column from the new table.
advanced.addColumnHelp: Adds another column to the new table.
advanced.createTableHelp: Creates the empty table now. Every row also gets an ID number and the date it was added, automatically.
advanced.createTableError: Couldn't create that table. Use letters, numbers and underscores in names.

privacy.typeAccess: Wants a copy of their data
privacy.sourceInApp: done by the person in the app
privacy.sourceWebLink: confirmed by the person from an emailed link
privacy.sourceWebForm: sent from the app's delete-account page
privacy.overdue: {days, plural, one {Overdue by # day} other {Overdue by # days}}
privacy.dueIn: {days, plural, one {Due in # day ({date})} other {Due in # days ({date})}}
privacy.loadOffline: Couldn't load your privacy requests. Check your connection.
privacy.actionError: That didn't work. Please try again.
privacy.searchError: The search didn't work. Please try again.
privacy.downloadError: The download didn't work. Please try again.
privacy.downloaded: Downloaded. Send the file to the person, and the request is logged as done.
privacy.eraseError: Erasing didn't work. Nothing was changed.
privacy.erased: Erased: {summary}. The request is logged as done.
privacy.intro: When someone asks what your app keeps about them, or asks you to delete it, find them here by email or phone. You have 30 days to answer.
privacy.deletePage: People can also delete their own account, or ask you to, on your app's delete-account page. App stores ask for this address:
privacy.copyHelp: Copies this address so you can paste it into your app store listing, where they ask for a delete-account page.
privacy.waitingBody: These people asked to delete their account from your app's delete-account page. Approving deletes their account and what's tied to it; bookings or orders with their email are kept with their details removed.
privacy.approveHelp: Deletes this person’s account and what’s tied to it (you’ll confirm first). Orders or bookings are kept with their details removed. This can’t be undone.
privacy.approveConfirm: Delete the account for {email} and what's tied to it? This can't be undone.
privacy.dismissHelp: Takes this request off the list without deleting anything, for example if it’s spam or you’ve already handled it.
privacy.openHelp: Privacy requests you still need to answer, soonest deadline first.
privacy.markDoneHelp: Marks this request as answered and moves it to Recently done. Use it once you’ve replied to the person.
privacy.logged: Request logged. It's due 30 days after it arrived.
privacy.logLabel: Someone asked by email or phone? Log it
privacy.logTypeHelp: What the person asked for. Logging it lets you track the 30 days you have to answer.
privacy.arrivedOnHelp: The day the request reached you. The 30 days to answer count from this date.
privacy.addToLogHelp: Adds this request to Open requests so you can keep track of its deadline. Nothing is deleted or sent.
privacy.recentlyDoneHelp: The last few requests you finished, for your records.
privacy.queryHelp: Type the person’s email address or phone number to see what your app keeps about them. Searching doesn’t change anything.
privacy.nothingFound: Nothing in your app's database is tied to {who}.
privacy.keepRows: Keep these rows for my records (orders, invoices) and only remove the personal details.
privacy.keepRowsLinked: Keep these rows for my records (orders, invoices) and only remove the personal details. Rows tied to their account ({count}) are still deleted.
privacy.rowsDeleted: {count, plural, one {# row will be deleted.} other {# rows will be deleted.}}
privacy.mentionedBody: These rows mention them somewhere in their text. Check them yourself; erasing doesn't change them.
privacy.openTableHelp: Open this table to check these rows yourself.
privacy.checkYourselfBody: These tables live in Google Sheets or your own database. The app can only read them, so look for this person there.
privacy.runLogs: {count, plural, one {# workflow log mentions them. Erasing clears what was sent in it.} other {# workflow logs mention them. Erasing clears what was sent in them.}}
privacy.answersHelp: Which open request this answers, so it’s marked as done when you download or erase. Pick “A new request” if it isn’t on your list.
privacy.newRequest: A new request (it's logged as done)
privacy.downloadHelp: Downloads everything found about this person as a file you can send them. The request is then logged as done.
privacy.eraseStartHelp: Shows what would be deleted and lets you keep some rows for your records. Nothing is deleted until you press Erase now.
privacy.eraseNowHelp: Deletes this person’s data as described below and logs the request as done. This can’t be undone.
privacy.eraseWarning: Erasing deletes the rows above (or removes the personal details where you chose to keep rows) and clears the workflow logs that mention them. It can't be undone. Download a copy first if they asked for one.

api.somethingWrong: Something went wrong reading your data. Please try again.
api.tableNotSetUp: This table hasn't been set up in your app's database yet.
api.noIdNote: This table has no ID column, so its rows can only be viewed here.
api.cantSortBy: You can't sort by that column.
api.sourceUnreachable: We couldn't reach this data source. Check its settings under Advanced.
api.sheetsNote: This table lives in Google Sheets, so you can look at it here but make changes in the sheet itself. Showing up to the first {count} rows.
api.outsideNote: This table lives in your own database, so you can look at it here but not change it. Showing up to the first {count} rows.
api.outsideReadOnly: This table lives in Google Sheets or your own database, so it can't be changed here.
api.cantChangeTable: This table can't be changed here.
api.secretsReadOnly: Passwords and secret keys can't be changed here.
api.autoColumn: "{label}" is filled in automatically and can't be changed.
api.rowGone: That row isn't there any more.
api.pickRows: Pick at least one row to delete.
api.tooManyRows: You can delete up to 500 rows at a time.
api.enterContact: Enter an email address or a phone number.
api.enterFullContact: Enter a full email address, or a phone number with at least 6 digits.
api.confirmErase: Check what will be erased, then confirm.
api.privacyFailed: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed. Please try again.
api.chooseDay: Choose the day the request arrived.
api.requestGone: That request isn't in the log any more.
